purpose: 25 station × 121 hotspot editorial knowledge coverage — targets, NOT achievements

policy.evidence: Every factual claim requires at least one checked source. Sensitive, historical dates and changing administrative facts need independent corroboration where possible.
policy.privacy: No student address, home-school route, session transcript or personal data in the research pack. Aggregate consent-based evaluation only.
policy.deployment: Static or lazy-loaded JSON shards, default local retrieval; optional explicit teacher-only paid AI.
